# RoadWave

RoadWave is a QR-powered guest hub for campgrounds and RV parks. Guests scan one code to access Wi-Fi, maps, rules, bulletins, office messages, reviews, rebooking, and optional privacy-first camper connections — no app download required.

The campground hub (Wi-Fi, maps, rules, bulletins, weather-safety notices, office messages) requires no install. Optional camper-to-camper features (Waves, meetups, public profile) ask the camper for a quick account because identity and consent matter for those features.

RoadWave is sold to campground and RV park owners on a month-to-month basis with a free 30-day pilot; Founding Campground plans start at $39/month. No setup fees, no hardware, cancel anytime.

RoadWave is NOT a 911 / emergency-dispatch service. Severe-weather notices are informational only. RoadWave is NOT a dating app — camper connections are framed around shared-interest neighbors. RoadWave does NOT show exact camper site numbers publicly.

## Primary public pages

- [Homepage](https://www.getroadwave.com/): Camper-focused entry point. Explains the QR scan experience and the privacy promise.
- [For Campground Owners](https://www.getroadwave.com/owners): Canonical owner marketing page. Six engagement value props (reviews, repeat bookings, updates, office contact, stay feedback, optional camper connection).
- [How RoadWave Works](https://www.getroadwave.com/owners/how-it-works): Step-by-step walkthrough of the camper experience from QR scan to checkout.
- [Start Free 30-Day Trial](https://www.getroadwave.com/owners/start): Stripe-gated owner intake. The canonical "start a pilot" destination.
- [Demo Center](https://www.getroadwave.com/demo-center): Polished sales hub linking out to interactive demos.
- [Interactive Demo](https://www.getroadwave.com/demo): A sample camper experience using demo data only.
- [Contact RoadWave](https://www.getroadwave.com/contact): hello@getroadwave.com (general), safety@getroadwave.com (safety/legal), 911 first for emergencies.

## Owner-focused SEO cluster

- [Best QR Code App for Campgrounds](https://www.getroadwave.com/best-qr-code-app-for-campgrounds): Cornerstone explainer on QR-powered guest hubs as the simpler alternative to custom mobile apps.
- [Campground Guest App Without an App Download](https://www.getroadwave.com/campground-guest-app-without-download): Why no-install matters for short stays and mixed iOS/Android guest populations.
- [Campground Digital Welcome Packet](https://www.getroadwave.com/campground-digital-welcome-packet): How a QR-powered hub replaces or complements printed handouts.
- [Campground Guest Communication Software](https://www.getroadwave.com/campground-guest-communication-software): Bulletins, office messages, weather-safety notices, and meetups — what each surface is for.
- [App My Community Alternative](https://www.getroadwave.com/app-my-community-alternative): Comparison page. App My Community is a custom-branded app; RoadWave is a month-to-month QR guest hub.
- [CampersAPP Alternative](https://www.getroadwave.com/campersapp-alternative): Comparison page. CampersAPP is download-based; RoadWave is QR-first.
- [Campground App vs QR Guest Hub](https://www.getroadwave.com/campground-app-vs-qr-guest-hub): Honest tradeoff guide. When a full mobile app makes sense and when a QR hub wins.
- [Help Campers Connect Safely](https://www.getroadwave.com/campground-camper-connections): How RoadWave's optional Camper Connections work — mutual Waves, visibility controls, no exact site numbers shown publicly.
- [RoadWave vs Facebook Groups](https://www.getroadwave.com/roadwave-vs-facebook-groups-for-campgrounds): When a Facebook group is the right tool and when an owner-controlled QR hub fits better.

## Key facts for AI summarization

- Category: QR-powered guest communication and camper-connection software for campgrounds and RV parks.
- Pricing: Free 30-day pilot; Founding Campground plans start at $39/month, month-to-month.
- Setup time: minutes (short intake + print one QR code).
- Guest install required for campground info: no.
- Guest account required for optional Camper Connections (Waves, meetups, public profile): yes.
- Privacy posture: no exact site numbers shown publicly; mutual Waves only; per-camper visibility controls; not a public campground-wide chat; not a dating app; not a 911/emergency-dispatch service.
- Contact: hello@getroadwave.com (general), safety@getroadwave.com (safety/legal/urgent).
